tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazdy z ponizszych dialogow (1.1-1.6), wybierajac odpowiedz A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Hello, could I speak to Mrs Kowalska, please?
Y: _________
options: A) I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I take a message?
B) I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I leave a message?
C) I'm afraid she's in a meeting. Can I give a message?
A) I'm calling Anna Nowak from the language school.
B) It's Anna Nowak from the language school.

items.stem:
X: I'm afraid you've got the wrong number.
Y: _________
options: A) Oh, thank you very much for all your help.
B) Oh, could you put me through to the right one?
C) Oh, I'm sorry to have bothered you.

items.stem:
X: Could you ask her to ring me back when she's free?
Y: _________
options: A) Of course. Could I have your number?
B) Of course. She'll ring you back when you're free.
C) Of course. I'll ring her back when I'm free.

items.stem:
X: Sorry, the line's breaking up. I can hardly hear you.
Y: _________
options: A) Yes, the line broke down yesterday as well.
B) Shall I call you back from the landline?
C) Don't worry, I can hear you hardly.

items.stem:
X: Thanks for calling. I'll be in touch soon.
Y: _________
options: A) Great, I look forward to hear from you.
B) Great, I'm looking forward to hear from you.
C) Great, I look forward to hearing from you.
